description: Graded relevance of the seven fictional demo resumes (demo_samples/resumes) for four sample jobs from data/sample_job_descriptions.json. 3 = strong fit (the role the resume describes), 2 = partial (core tools overlap), 1 = weak (same broad field), 0 = unrelated. The Data Scientist labels are the 'Expected fit' column of demo_samples/README.md; the other three were assigned on 30 Oct 2026 by reading each resume against the job text. Only seven resumes, so treat results as a sanity check, not an accuracy measure.
